title: Naturality of the adjunction mate across a cube
statement: For eight categories and four adjunctions F ⊣ R, K ⊣ S, F′ ⊣ R′, K′ ⊣ S′, let a,b,c,d connect corresponding categories, and let pF,pG,pH,pK be invertible comparison squares. Suppose θ:G⋙K → F⋙H and θ′:G′⋙K′ → F′⋙H′ have equal composites around the inverse-image cube. Then the mates of θ and θ′ satisfy the corresponding right-adjoint cube equation, where the comparisons on R and S are the mates of pF.inv and pK.inv. The displayed Lean signature specifies all domains and orientations.

proof.text: Transpose both sides by K′ ⊣ S′. Expand the two mate components using unit-square-counit. Apply naturality of pH, the counits and the comparison mates; substitute the inverse-image cube equation. The triangle identities identify the resulting composites.

lean.statement:
theorem exchangeMate_cube
    {A B C D A' B' C' D' : Type*}
    [Category A] [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
    [Category A'] [Category B'] [Category C'] [Category D']
    {F : A ⥤ B} {R : B ⥤ A} {G : A ⥤ C} {H : B ⥤ D}
    {K : C ⥤ D} {S : D ⥤ C}
    {F' : A' ⥤ B'} {R' : B' ⥤ A'} {G' : A' ⥤ C'} {H' : B' ⥤ D'}
    {K' : C' ⥤ D'} {S' : D' ⥤ C'}
    (adj : F ⊣ R) (adjK : K ⊣ S) (adj' : F' ⊣ R') (adjK' : K' ⊣ S')
    (a : A ⥤ A') (b : B ⥤ B') (c : C ⥤ C') (d : D ⥤ D')
    (pF : F ⋙ b ≅ a ⋙ F') (pG : G ⋙ c ≅ a ⋙ G')
    (pH : H ⋙ d ≅ b ⋙ H') (pK : K ⋙ d ≅ c ⋙ K')
    (θ : G ⋙ K ⟶ F ⋙ H) (θ' : G' ⋙ K' ⟶ F' ⋙ H')
    (hc : ∀ X : A,
      K'.map (pG.inv.app X) ≫ pK.inv.app (G.obj X) ≫ d.map (θ.app X) =
        θ'.app (a.obj X) ≫ H'.map (pF.inv.app X) ≫ pH.inv.app (F.obj X))
    (E : B) :
    c.map ((mateEquiv adj adjK (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ θ)).app E) ≫
        (mateEquiv adjK adjK' (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ pK.inv)).app (H.obj E) ≫
        S'.map (pH.hom.app E) =
      pG.hom.app (R.obj E) ≫
        G'.map ((mateEquiv adj adj' (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ pF.inv)).app E) ≫
        (mateEquiv adj' adjK' (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ θ')).app (b.obj E)
